id./param/scenario/cs/a_080_cs_040.pack|cs_: Hey! Let go already! A kid like you won't be using Veronica's wand for another hundred years!
You're a kid too! Lending it for a minute won't kill you!
What's going on with this one?
I was walking along when that boy suddenly snatched Veronica's wand. I've been chasing him all the way here.
Ah!
There. Don't let anyone steal it again.
Veronica got her wand back from Erik!
...Tell me. What did you plan to do with my wand? It wouldn't fetch much if you sold it.
...What is it with you?
Ugh, fine. Placido, don't force yourself. I'll explain.
I'm Rad, and this is my buddy Placido. He's the mayor's only son. The mayor is Rotondo.
Rad
We used to play together all the time, but a few days ago he lost his voice. I asked what happened, but he couldn't tell me.
Rad
So I figured if I used a mage's wand, its magic might cure his throat...
Well, if that's the reason, I suppose it can't be helped. More to the point, this Placido boy can't be left like this.
It seems a very powerful curse has been placed on his throat. Who would do such a terrible thing...
A magical nectar called songbird nectar should lift the curse, but making it needs holy water from a pure spring.
Rad
Water from a pure spring... If we get that, can we save Placido? Then I've heard of a place!
Rad
West of town there's a place called the Spirit Water Cave. They say there's a super pretty spring at the back.
Rad
Hey, mister, miss. Placido and I have been like brothers since we were little.
Rad
I know I stole from you and all, but please think of it as a request from him, since he can't talk. Help get his voice back?
...You're pretty petty, you know that? The boy did nothing wrong. We've nothing better to do, so we'll help.
Rad
Thanks, mister, miss! Make the songbird nectar with the spring water from the cave to the west and bring it back!
id./param/scenario/cs/a_080_cs_045.pack|cs_: Oh... such clear spring water! With this, we can surely make the finest songbird nectar!
Serena scooped up the spring water and mixed it with medicine to make songbird nectar!
It's finished, {var:1}. Let's hurry back to Gondolia and give it to the boy.
id./param/scenario/cs/a_080_cs_050.pack|cs_: Oh my... the town has changed completely into contest mode while we were gone! {var:1}, look!
Ooh, how romantic! Soon a lineup of gorgeous men will be up on that stage!
{var:1} darling, Erik darling. I want to see Placido's face, so we three girls will deliver the nectar.
In return, you and Erik can claim us a spot for the contest. Pick one where we can see the handsome men!
Leaving all the annoying work to the men... Eh, fine. Nothing else to do. Let's head to the square.
